claims.text: Asana offers a free Personal plan.
The Starter plan costs $10.99 per user per month when billed annually.
When billed monthly, the Starter plan costs $13.49 per user per month.
The Advanced plan costs $24.99 per user per month when billed annually.
When billed monthly, the Advanced plan costs $30.49 per user per month.
Enterprise and Enterprise Plus plans use custom pricing.
Native time tracking is available on Advanced, Enterprise, and Enterprise Plus plans.
The Timesheets and Budgets add-on is licensed on a per-user basis.
SAML-based SSO requires an Enterprise or Enterprise Plus plan.
Paid plans include Asana AI features such as AI Teammates, Asana Dash, and AI Studio.
Native time tracking allows users to record time via an embedded timer or by manually logging hours for each task.
The Timesheets and Budgets add-on lets teams log time directly on tasks, separate billable and non-billable hours, submit timesheets for approval, and view real-time updates in dashboards.
A single task can be added to multiple projects simultaneously, with any changes syncing automatically across all projects.
Asana does not support assigning multiple users directly to a single task, though subtasks can each have different owners.
Asana is positioned to focus on internal task management and team collaboration rather than client work.
Asana sees its strongest adoption in marketing and advertising, information technology services, computer software, and non-profit organization management.
Monday.com holds a strong presence in marketing and advertising, information technology services, computer software, construction, and non-profit management.
Monday.com's mobile app holds a 4.7-star rating on the Apple App Store, compared to Asana's 4.5-star rating as of the first quarter of 2026.
ClickUp offers more than 1,000 native integrations, compared with over 200 each for Asana and Monday.com.
One review positions Asana as a stronger fit for structured workflows and granular control across multiple projects.
Monday.com is positioned as stronger for visual project tracking and layout flexibility.
One review gives Jira an overall rating of 4 out of 5 and names it best for software teams and customizable dashboards.
Jira supports explicit issue relationships such as blocks and is blocked by, whereas Asana handles simpler task dependencies.
On G2, 94% of reviewers rate Asana's creation and assignment features positively.
On G2, 93% of reviewers rate Asana's due dates features positively.
On G2, 92% of reviewers commend Asana's project and task list organization.
On G2, Monday.com receives ratings of 94% for creation and assignment, 94% for due dates, and 93% for task prioritization.
One comparison lists Asana at $13.49 per user per month versus Jira at $7.91 per user per month.
Asana holds a 4.4 out of 5 overall rating from more than 13,000 verified G2 reviews as of May 2026.
Ninety-four percent of G2 reviewers rate Asana's task creation and assignment features positively.
Ninety-two percent of G2 users commend Asana's project and task list organization.
Asana reported $216.4 million in revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, a 10% increase year over year.
Asana's dollar-based net retention rate reached 97% in the second quarter of fiscal 2027.

One review describes Asana as a solid and user-friendly project management tool with an interface that serves as a major selling point, though it notes the tool is not as powerful as some competitors.
Microsoft SSO lets teams sign in with existing Microsoft credentials, and administrators on paid plans can require it as the organization-wide login method. (judge: not_stated)
An audit log API built to support SIEM is included in the platform. (judge: not_stated)
Enterprise and Enterprise Plus plans include user provisioning through SCIM and universal resource management. (judge: not_stated)
Integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Adobe Creative Cloud, Tableau, Gmail, and Jira Cloud are available in the Advanced tier and above. (judge: not_stated)
Jira sees its highest adoption in IT services and computer software industries. (judge: not_stated)
On G2 as of the first quarter of 2026, Monday.com holds an overall score of 4.7 out of 5 from over 12,000 reviews, while Asana scores 4.4 out of 5 from over 10,000 reviews. (judge: not_stated)
On Capterra, Monday.com holds a 4.6 out of 5 rating from over 5,200 reviews, compared to Asana's 4.5 out of 5 from over 13,000 reviews. (judge: not_stated)
Asana scores higher than Monday.com on G2 for workflow customization, with a rating of 4.5 out of 5 versus 4.3 out of 5. (judge: not_stated)
Asana scores higher than Monday.com on G2 for enterprise administration, with a rating of 4.5 out of 5 versus 4.2 out of 5. (judge: not_stated)
On G2, Jira receives ratings of 94% for creation and assignment, 93% for issue tracking, and 92% for task prioritization. (judge: not_stated)
Some G2 users note that reporting features are limited on basic plans and that automation capabilities are less robust than those of some competing tools. (judge: not_stated)
